title: Kirkmont Center

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Calling all young campers from kindergarten through grade 3 to a great adventure! Whether it’s your first time at a sleep away camp, you want a shorter camp, or you are returning to beginners for more fun, this camp is for you! This 3 night Sunday pm through Wed pm adventure will satisfy with music, crafts, hiking, fishing, swimming, campfire, learning, praising, creating, and much more!! Qualified staff members keep your child a priority and ensure the best camp experience! Come join the fun! Are you ready to embark on a week filled with excitement, exploration, and new friendships? Kirkmont Camp offers a fantastic opportunity for campers to immerse themselves in a variety of activities
